venira.avoid_when: you read or edit files (file tools) or run a tiny JS calculation (execute_js).
venira.output_kind: run_id, kill_key, running, exit_code, timed_out, stdout/stderr (background=false) or stdout_tail/stderr_tail. ok=true only means the call ran; status (completed|failed|running|cancelled) and command_status describe the command. shell_path/shell_kind name the binary that ran it (on Windows bash may be the WSL launcher). approval_required: ask the user to approve, then retry once with approval_id. repeated_failure: the identical invocation already failed; read data.previous.stderr_tail, then change the command or pass retry_failed=true.
venira.speed_profile: background=true returns in ~5 ms, run time is up to the command; background=false blocks for the whole run (bounded by timeout_s, default 10 min).
venira.use_when: you build, test, run git or install packages. background=false for short commands you need now.

description:
Run a shell command in the workspace (shell, relative_cwd, timeout_s). Default is background: returns run_id, poll shell_status. background=false blocks until exit and returns stdout/stderr.
Use when: you build, test, run git or install packages. background=false for short commands you need now.
Avoid when: you read or edit files (file tools) or run a tiny JS calculation (execute_js).
Output: run_id, kill_key, running, exit_code, timed_out, stdout/stderr (background=false) or stdout_tail/stderr_tail. ok=true only means the call ran; status (completed|failed|running|cancelled) and command_status describe the command. shell_path/shell_kind name the binary that ran it (on Windows bash may be the WSL launcher). approval_required: ask the user to approve, then retry once with approval_id. repeated_failure: the identical invocation already failed; read data.previous.stderr_tail, then change the command or pass retry_failed=true.

approval_id.description: Id from approval_required, granted by a human (`data.approval.approve_command` or client elicitation). Retry once.

approval_wait_s.description: If approval is needed, wait up to this many seconds (max 45; fractional ok) for the human, then run in the same call.

background.description: true = background (default): return immediately with run_id. false = foreground: block until the command exits, then return the final stdout/stderr in this call.

dry_run.description: true = evaluate policy only; nothing runs, no approval is created (default false).

override.description: Named exception; only works when the operator enabled this exact name in VENIRA_SHELL_OVERRIDES.

relative_cwd.description: Working directory inside the workspace (default: workspace root).

retry_failed.description: true = rerun an identical invocation that already failed (default false: refused with repeated_failure and the previous stderr tail).

secret_env.description: Stored secret names (secret) injected as env vars, e.g. ["GITHUB_TOKEN"]. Values never appear in the command, audit log or output.

shell.description: Default: VENIRA_DEFAULT_SHELL, else the host default. pwsh = PowerShell 7+, powershell = 5.1.

timeout_s.description: Kill the process tree after this many seconds (0/unset = 10 min; fractional ok; capped by VENIRA_SHELL_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS).
